items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He sent for me and asked if I wanted to work there on 14th Street with him. I said sure.

ctx.x: Yeah, let's go to Buffalo. He wanted to go to Buffalo. I said, 'I don't want to go to Buffalo.' 'Maybe I'll stay around New York for a while.' So, my two oldest brothers, Bill and Floyd, they went to Buffalo. Now they worked around Buffalo -- they had their own little combos around there -- they worked around Buffalo for a long while. They stayed in Buffalo for quite a while. And I stayed in New York. And this is when I met June Clark. He was playing down at a dance -- 14th Street -- a little
